title: {B} square (boss)
hints: Eight bananas around the edge, and the monkey stands on one.
One side: step, grab, step, grab, turn. Repeat it 4 times.

sk.title: Štvorec: {B.few} (boss)
hints: Osem banánov po okraji a opička stojí na jednom.
Jedna strana: krok, chyť, krok, chyť, otoč sa. Zopakuj 4-krát.
